back.target: to sit, to be sitting (to be in a seated position)
back.example: I'm sitting in the car and waiting for you.

note: The hint is needed to rule out sich setzen, and sameAs is rightly null because sentar-sit-down means sich setzen; the editor may want to know that southern Germany, Austria and Switzerland form the Perfekt with sein (ich bin gesessen), though that is a grammar variant rather than a different word, so regional can stay null.
